name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: A typed date input paired with a calendar popover over one value, for single dates (`DatePicker`) or ranges (`DateRangePicker`). Supports month- and year-only granularity, `unavailableRanges`, and a non-modal popover: the input stays editable while the calendar is open, and the calendar follows what is typed.
